about_the_game: This demo gives a glimpse into a dystopian wasteland where humans have turned feral, forming twisted factions that are going after the cats for mysterious reasons. This is an action adventure game with snarky dialogue and inspired by some of the best post- apocalyptic games out there. You play as a battle-hardened cat fighting to survive. Whether you go solo or team up in multiplayer, you'll claw through missions, loot gear, and unravel the mystery behind the human downfall. Apocalypse Meow is the ultimate catfight for survival.

short_description: The fur flies in a post-human wasteland where cats have to claw their way through a world overrun by crazy human factions. Equip yourself with weapons to battle through chaotic missions and uncover the secrets behind humanity's downfall. It's a world where cats don't just survive but they dominate.
